title: Compatible MTEXT scalar view fast slice
scope: Remove one temporary source std::string per scalar in compatible-mode MTEXT encoding
Preserve AC1018 legacy-codepage ASCII and Binary output behavior
Keep the change internal to dxfWriter with no public layout/API change

changes: Changed internal dxfWriter::fromUtf8String() to accept std::string_view; its encoder and strict conversion path already consume views.
Compatible writeUtf8MTextChunks() now forwards each scalar substring view directly instead of constructing a temporary std::string.
Added generated ASCII/Binary AC1018 ANSI_932 MTEXT controls for an exact 249-byte boundary chunk, CP932 bytes 93 FA, continuation/final groups, and semantic readback.
limitations: Encoded scalar output strings and destination chunk storage remain allocated.
Strict-mode scalar temporaries and other writer/projection copies remain separate work.
This is not an allocator-capacity, peak-RSS, or full conversion performance claim.
